# Muslimi Digital

> AI-powered digital business diagnosis for the Albanian market. A free 2-minute questionnaire reveals which digital services (web, SEO, Google Maps, social media, 360° media) a business is missing compared to competitors.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Hero, free diagnosis CTA, AI business analyzer.
- [Diagnozë falas](/diagnoze): 6-question diagnostic flow.
- [Analizo biznesin me AI](/analizo-biznesin): Conversational AI consultant that interviews the business.
- [Case Studies](/case-studies): Real client results.
- [Historiku](/historiku): Past diagnosis sessions.
- [Krahaso](/krahaso): Compare your business with competitors.

## Services

- [Faqe 3D / Web 3D](/services/web-3d): Modern 3D websites that convert.
- [SEO](/services/seo): Google first-page optimization.
- [Google Maps](/services/google-maps): Local profile optimization.
- [Social Media](/services/social-media): Content + strategy.
- [Foto & Video 360°](/services/360-media): Immersive visual experiences.
